review_template.population: Required: studied population, age, sex/physiological context
review_template.indication: Required: outcome and clinical context, not marketing claim
review_template.evidence: Required: systematic reviews, guidelines and relevant trials with date/DOI/URL
review_template.effect_size: Record clinically meaningful benefit and uncertainty; do not invent
review_template.protocol: Record studied dose/form/timing/duration only when source verified
review_template.safety: Interactions, contraindications, upper limits, product quality, special populations
review_template.question_dependencies: Map to canonical question bank and new proposals
review_template.decision: eligible / limited / insufficient / avoid / professional review
review_template.review: Reviewer and date required before activation

review_rules: Evaluate clinical effect and harms, not just mechanistic plausibility
Strain-specific probiotics and compound-specific combinations cannot inherit generic claims
Salt and chemical forms must inherit cumulative intake safety checks
No default personalized dosing for 60 missing deep records
next_action: Research and create verified deep records in manageable source-backed batches; no automatic recommendation activation.
